evidence.quote: Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips.
evidence.one_line: Unnamed report says Nvidia told a board partner that RTX 50 Super products are on hold because of 3GB GDDR7 memory prices; a VideoCardz source confirmed a partner already has the cards on hand.
evidence.speaker: VideoCardz source (via Tom's Hardware)

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025 as the memory chip crisis unfolded.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia stopped supplying VRAM chips with GPU dies to board partners in late 2025, so partners must source their own memory.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales)

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the "worst year" for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales)

evidence.quote: This is the first time this has happened in five years, with Jensen Huang releasing the 30-series, 40-series, and their respective mid-generation refreshes despite supply chain limitations and several other issues that arose during that period.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia did not announce a new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years it has not done so.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales)

evidence.quote: Its latest AI systems are now more expensive than ever, with memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia's latest AI systems: memory is 25% of the bill of materials and system costs have risen nearly 500%, per the publication.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales)

evidence.quote: The RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumored to have 3GB GDDR7 chips , which offers 50% more capacity than the 2GB found in current-gen RTX 50-series graphics cards.
evidence.one_line: RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumored to use 3GB GDDR7 chips, 50% more capacity per chip than the 2GB in current RTX 50 cards.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales)

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants, which will likely push the retail price of these cards beyond Nvidia's envisioned MSRP.
evidence.one_line: 3GB GDDR7 chips reportedly cost two to three times as much as 2GB variants, likely pushing RTX 50 Super retail prices above Nvidia's MSRP.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (Jowi Morales)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia launch the RTX 50 Super GPUs by 2027-02-28?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: RTX 50 Super GPUs are launched by 2027-02-28

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: RTX 50 Super GPUs are not launched by 2027-02-28

candidates.settled_by: Nvidia product announcements and launch press release
